tips_en: Read the Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR) paper first: it presents a crisp hypothesis about why recurrent depth fails to generalize, then validates its two-part fix with unusually clear ablations. It connects to BrainLoRA and Matrix-Game 4.0 through the broader theme of making iterative computation reliable and efficient—explicitly supervising intermediate progress, stabilizing internal states, and separating state updates from repeated inference.
tips_zh: 建议先读进度对齐递归（PAR）论文：它清楚提出了循环深度无法泛化的原因，并通过消融实验有力验证了由进度监督和归一化锚定组成的关键方案。它与 BrainLoRA 和 Matrix-Game 4.0 的共同联系在于让迭代计算更可靠、高效——显式监督中间进度、稳定内部状态，并将状态更新与重复推理解耦。
